message:
Nothing big confirmed locally, so it's DIY school holidays: 18-19C, grey Saturday and a sprinkle of drizzle Sunday. Pack jumpers, snacks and a lot of patience 🧥
Dawesville weekend: 5/10

Dawesville Weekend Assessment

A mild spring weekend ahead: clear and 19 degrees Friday, overcast and 18 Saturday, and a token drizzle at 17 on Sunday. 9 to 5 The Musical closes at ManPAC on Sunday, the Mandurah Arts Festival rolls on, and the Roosters meet the Knights in Sunday's NRL Grand Final. With the kids on holidays, Saturday's Peel Produce Market at the foreshore makes a fine outing, ideally before anyone finds the remote.
Dawesville weekend: 6/10

Dawesville Weekend Assessment

A grey, drizzly weekend awaits, with tops of 15 to 17 degrees and a chilly 10-degree start on Sunday. The Mandurah Arts Festival bows out with free Music Under the Bridge on Saturday evening and the Movers & Makers family day on Sunday morning, while Room on the Broom plays ManPAC on Friday. Pack a raincoat alongside the picnic rug, as the final weekend of the school holidays waits for no one. ☔
Dawesville weekend: 5/10

Dawesville Weekend Assessment

Friday stays dry but overcast at 19 degrees, before light showers arrive on Saturday (20) and Sunday (18) under gentle winds. Pirates of Penzance plays ManPAC all weekend, and Sunday brings Pinjarra Garden Day at Edenvale plus the Mandjar Markets. With crabbing closed until December, the blue swimmers get another weekend off, so pack an umbrella and admire someone else's roses ☂️
Dawesville weekend: 5/10

Dawesville Weekend Assessment

Expect drizzle on Friday, a near-certain soaking Saturday and tops of only 15C, with Sunday largely drying out. ManPAC hosts comedian Ivan Aristeguieta on Saturday and the Dancing in the Shadows of Motown tribute on Sunday, while Saturday's free Community Safety Expo in Mandurah offers emergency vehicles for the kids. Save outdoor plans for Sunday; the expo's best safety tip may be an umbrella. ☔
Dawesville weekend: 4/10

Dawesville Weekend Assessment

• Cool, 15-16C, Saturday showers, Sunday driest; 29km/h southerlies, boat stays home.
• Crabs closed till 30 Nov; the Cut usually gives spring herring, whiting.
• Peel Produce Market, Dawesville Foreshore, Saturday morning - bring a brolly ☂️

Dawesville Weekend Assessment

• Drizzly, 18-20C; Saturday's showers bring 12mm. Brolly beats bucket hat.
• Crabs closed till 30 Nov; herring and whiting usually around the Cut.
• Sat: free Halloween Fun Day at The Cut Golf Course, Dawesville 🎃
